mcp_server_audit.task: Audit the MCP server we expose to third-party agents: tool descriptions, the authorization boundary on each tool, and what a malicious server in the same session could do.

k8s_cluster_audit.task: Do a security audit of our Kubernetes cluster: RBAC and escalation paths, admission control, what a compromised pod can reach, and whether workloads are isolated from each other.

next_security_review.task: Security-review our Next.js app: the Server Action boundary, what leaks from server to client components, hydration, and the CSS/accessibility regressions the last redesign introduced.

untrusted_feed_ingest.task: We ingest third-party RSS feeds and user-uploaded archives and parse them server-side. Harden that path.

evidence_shell_script.task: Review deploy-attest.sh, the script that writes our build attestation ledger and verifies it before release.

crypto_key_rotation.task: We need to rotate the signing keys for our API tokens without downtime, and move them out of environment variables.

agent_subagent_delegation.task: Our coding agent spawns subagents that sometimes duplicate each other's work and occasionally run shell commands we did not intend. Fix the delegation and tool-permission design.

browser_verification.task: Before we ship, verify in a real browser that the checkout flow works end to end and that nothing regressed visually or in accessibility.

single_go_error_control.task: Rewrite this Go function's error handling to wrap with %w and stop swallowing the sentinel.

single_ux_copy_control.task: Reword the error message shown when a password reset link has expired.
